title: Popover
summary: A small non-modal panel anchored to its trigger with a heading, body and actions; opens on click or hover, flips and shifts to stay on screen, closes on Escape, an outside press or focus leaving. variant="confirm" asks a yes/no question beside the control that was pressed. Declarative openers: data-open="#id", data-toggle and data-close work without any script (installed when the element connects).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no heading.

props.name: variant
props.description: confirm adds Cancel and Confirm buttons.

props.name: message
props.description: Body text for the confirm variant.

events.name: pk-close
events.description: Panel closed (escape, outside, cancel, confirm, toggle).

writes.why: aria-haspopup=dialog and aria-expanded (true or false, as the open state) describe the popup the trigger controls; refreshed on every open change and when the trigger is replaced. Kept when the element disconnects.

a11y: The trigger carries aria-expanded; the panel is role=dialog (role=alertdialog for confirm) with a label; focus moves in on keyboard open and returns to the trigger on close.
mobile: Width is min(20rem, viewport minus gutters); scrolls internally past the viewport height; buttons are 44px tall on a phone.

examples.title: Popover on click
examples.html: <pk-popover heading="Order 1042"><pk-button slot="trigger" variant="ghost">Details</pk-button>Placed Sep 12, three lines, shipping to Portland.</pk-popover>

examples.title: Confirmation popover
examples.html: <pk-popover variant="confirm" heading="Delete this line?" message="It cannot be undone." confirm-label="Delete" danger><pk-button slot="trigger" variant="warn">Delete line</pk-button></pk-popover>
